$Comment: What the Mastery Trainer gives back for a day's tribute.
ROLLS EVALUATE INDEPENDENTLY. Every roll whose Chance passes pays out on the same claim, so a
lucky day hands over several at once. The first roll always pays, and each one after it is a
bonus on top.
Chance is the probability that roll fires at all, 0 to 1; a roll with no Chance always fires.
Count and CountMax together are a range, rolled per grant.
THE ESSENCE ROLL IS A LADDER, which is what makes the daily grow with the player instead of
paying a beginner and a veteran the same handful. Its Factors are summed into one score and the
Floors are read against that score; floors are NOT cumulative, so the highest one reached wins
and only its Grants fire. Two things feed the score, weighted equally: combat level, so the
tribute pays better as the player gets stronger, and luck, so investing in luck pays here as
well as in the ground.
UNITS, the one trap worth knowing. Both channels are read as WHOLE NUMBERS: MMO_Luck stores
whole percent points, so a heavily invested player reads near 100 rather than near 1, and
MMO_CombatLevel is a level, not a fraction. The floors below are therefore written on a scale
of roughly 0 to 200. Never compose MMO_Luck together with the mmoskilltree:station_luck
aggregate: that one returns a fraction and counts the same investment twice.
The mastery point on the second roll is the one number to think about before retuning: a point
every other day is a real second income beside the milestones, and raising that Chance changes
how fast a player fills a track far more than any of the others.
The rare roll carries a Cue, the opaque celebration id a roll may author beside its Grants. It
fires only when the grants beside it genuinely paid out, and its id names the FeedbackMoment
that answers it (Rare_Find ships with the MMO jar as a toast and a chime). Reuse "Rare_Find"
on your own rare roll for the same celebration, or author a new Cue value plus a
Server/ZiggfreedCommon/FeedbackMoments file of that name for one of your own.
All the odds and floors here are opening balance. Retune them and the daily changes with no
other edit.
Name: Mmo_Mastery_Offering

Rolls.$Comment: Always pays, and pays more the further along the player is: the trainer never sends a student away empty-handed, and a veteran's offering is answered in kind. Floor 0 is what somebody who has only just met the trainer receives.

Floors.$Comment: The starting tier, reachable by anybody, since a score of 0 always passes.
A player who has fought a little or claimed a few luck rewards.
A committed player: a solid combat level with real luck investment behind it.
The top of the ladder, needing both halves near their ceiling rather than one alone.

Rolls.$Comment: The point itself, roughly two days in five. This is the roll that decides how much the daily is worth; treat any change here as a balance change to the whole mastery system.
The uncommon bonus: a short burst of faster learning across every skill. Roughly one day in ten.
The rare pull, and the reason to keep coming back: an adept's own bo staff. Roughly one day in thirty-three. The Cue plays the Rare_Find celebration the moment the staff actually lands.
